report.narrative: Fire reported in a apartment block on Bell Way. About 4 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Flames and smoke are visible.
Fire alarm and visible fire at a restaurant on Bailey Avenue. About 3 people are hurt. 1 looks badly hurt. Flames and smoke are visible.
Multiple cars collided on Hamilton Street and traffic has stopped. About 3 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet.
Heat and crowding at a gathering on Smith Street, many feel faint. Caller thinks maybe 4 people are hurt but cannot be sure. No one seems critical yet.
Multiple cars collided on Mccoy Way and traffic has stopped. About 4 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Someone is trapped.
Part of a restaurant on Moore Road has collapsed. About 3 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Debris is still coming down.
Crowd surge at an event on Richards Street, people are on the ground. Caller thinks maybe 4 people are hurt but cannot be sure. No one seems critical yet.
Caller sees flames and heavy smoke from a parking garage on Cobb Way. About 5 people are hurt. 1 looks badly hurt. Flames and smoke are visible.
Multiple cars collided on Miller Way and traffic has stopped. Caller thinks maybe 1 people are hurt but cannot be sure. No one seems critical yet.
Crowd surge at an event on Valencia Boulevard, people are on the ground. Caller thinks maybe 5 people are hurt but cannot be sure. 1 looks badly hurt.
Chain-reaction collision on Mcneil Road, caller is standing nearby. Caller thinks maybe 1 people are hurt but cannot be sure. 1 looks badly hurt. Someone is trapped.
Unknown vapor cloud near Garcia Road, workers are evacuating. About 2 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. There is a strong chemical smell.

meta.description: Mixed urban mass-casualty day: crashes, fires, a collapse, a spill and a crowd event.
